user.title: Connect to Tracearr
user.description: Create a key in Tracearr > Settings > Data & API > API.

abort.already_configured: This Tracearr instance is already configured

edit_alias.title: Personalize {account}
edit_alias.description: Leave a field empty to restore its default.

raw_maps.title: Advanced customization
raw_maps.description: JSON mappings: account names such as plex:alice mapped to Alice. Custom avatar URLs must use HTTPS.

network_manual.title: Manual device
network_manual.description: For inactive clients. Enter the exact device or player name reported by Tracearr.

network_json.title: Advanced network rules
network_json.description: Example rules: device:Apple TV = local; player:Plex Web = remote.

aliases_table.title: User display names
aliases_table.description: One field per account. Leave blank to use the original name. Existing aliases are prefilled.

devices_plex.title: Plex — Local or Remote
devices_plex.description: Choose one state per device. A server-wide choice also applies to future devices and clears individual overrides for this server. Reopen to customize exceptions.

devices_jellyfin.title: Jellyfin — Local or Remote
